title: Backend feature-slice restructure and frontend functional remediation
description: Incrementally restructure ZhongWenHub inside the existing Api, Business, Data and tests layers using feature-first organization inspired by DuAnTuyenDung, while fixing production frontend API errors, mock fallbacks and non-persistent actions.
acceptance_criteria: Work starts with Phase P0 and proceeds through separately reviewed pull requests
Existing /api/v1 routes, JSON contracts and authorization policies remain compatible
Program.cs, ContentController, ContentService and ApplicationDbContext are decomposed according to the documented size and responsibility goals
Backend optional SQL Server CI targets ZhongWenHub.IntegrationTests.csproj
Fresh and upgrade SQL Server migration scenarios pass without modifying applied migration files
Frontend API failures surface typed error states and are not converted into null success-like states
Production admin, dashboard, results, skills, teacher and support flows do not silently use mock or demo records
All supported mutations persist on the backend and remain correct after reload
Backend unit and integration tests pass
Frontend lint, unit tests, production build and Playwright role flows pass
Architecture tests prevent Data-to-Business/Api and controller-to-DbContext violations
ZhongWenHub_Dev remains unchanged under strict zero-write policy
safety_constraints: Never write to ZhongWenHub_Dev or production databases
Never force-push or merge directly to main
Do not reset, stash, discard or overwrite unrelated local changes
Do not copy hard-coded secrets, weak password settings or insecure configuration defaults from the reference repository
Do not rewrite applied EF migrations; add forward-only corrective migrations
Do not perform a big-bang directory move without characterization and contract tests
Stop after each phase and wait for Codex review before continuing
